title: Vetoes and missed agreements in language-model bargaining
abstract: arXiv:2611.30950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A language model played three representatives, each instructed to get the best payoff for its own group. One representative requested a plan, another chose the sole offer, and all three voted. If anyone voted no, each group received its fallback payoff. In 60 games with Qwen3-Next-80B, the representative at risk of a loss always requested a plan that would leave everyone better off. In each game, two copies of the proposer saw the same payoffs, peer request and reminder that the offer needed three yes votes. Showing the proposer how many groups gained under each plan raised mutually beneficial agreements from 6/60 to 31/60 (paired increase 41.7 percentage points, conservative 95% interval 18.8 to 58.5). Two of the four plans benefited everyone, so picking uniformly would put a mutual gain on the ballot half the time on average. translated_title: 语言模型谈判中的否决与错失的协议
translated_abstract: 一个语言模型扮演三名代表，每位代表都被指示为自己的群体争取最佳收益。一名代表提出方案请求，另一名代表选择唯一的提案，三人共同投票。如果任何人投反对票，每个群体都将获得其保底收益。在使用Qwen3-Next-80B进行的60场博弈中，面临损失风险的代表总是会请求一个能让所有人受益更多的方案。在每场博弈中，提案者的两个副本看到相同的收益、同伴的请求以及提案需要三票赞成的提醒。向提案者展示每个方案下有多少群体获益，使互惠协议从6/60提升到31/60（配对提升41.7个百分点，保守95%置信区间为18.8至58.5）。四个方案中有两个能让所有人受益，因此均匀随机选择平均而言会在一半的投票中产生互利结果。在更早的一项研究中，GPT-4.1在两种消息条件下进行了12场冲突博弈，多数规则通过了15（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 向语言模型谈判中的提案者展示每个方案下有多少群体获益，可使其互惠协议从6/60大幅提升至31/60，从而减少否决票和错失的双赢协议。
en_tdlr: Showing proposers in language-model bargaining how many groups gain under each plan raises mutually beneficial agreements from 6/60 to 31/60, reducing vetoes and missed win-win deals.
